description: Kaldvik AS engages in the salmon farming business in Iceland, the United States, the European Union, and internationally. It also owns and operates smolt stations. The company was formerly known as Ice Fish Farm AS and changed its name to Kaldvik AS in August 2024. Kaldvik AS was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Eskifjörður, Iceland. Kaldvik AS operates as a subsidiary of Austur Holding As.
